findings.summary: Checked rollback improved, but no phase journal; preflight failure is spent and triggers rollback; result-write ambiguity and rollback unlink race remain.
Pre-state and rollback authority remain pathname-based and lack descriptor identity, process start/boot/cgroup, and socket inode binding.
Basic singular/local/CUDA/model/smoke checks exist, but identity is PID/basename based and sustained L3 benchmark plus independent production proof are absent.
Installer reopens verified pathnames and can leave library/sbin artifacts published after later state/key/policy failure.
No external authenticated tip or framed EOF contract; deletion of a complete final record is accepted as a valid prefix.
Task/run can become terminal after the sole freshness check and mutation still executes.
Mutable pathname-based DB/request/queue authority is not descriptor anchored or owner/mode/inode sealed.
Rollback symlink check and unlink are separate pathname operations.
Prompt requires full hash but omits task/run and explicit operator identity; request read is TOCTOU-prone and operator assertion depends on PKEXEC_UID.
Fixed commands reduce leakage, but persisted stdout/stderr/exception fields lack explicit allowlist/redaction and full secret-canary coverage.
Duplicate approvals cause durable ambiguity; ledger/model traversal is unbounded; any allowed executor can spend the sole queue.
Uninstall leaves broker-created Ollama drop-in and possible switched service effect in place.
Hard-coded UID, host, paths, GPU and policy assumptions lack sealed install-time proof.

required_p0: descriptor-anchored authority, queue, pre-state, package and rollback paths
freshness rechecks before consume, mutation and commit
durable phase journal plus fixed inspect/reconcile
external authenticated ledger tip with bounded framing and independent key boundary
atomic installer publication with complete cleanup and kill-phase fixtures
